title: GamePatchKit manifest signature
description: Canonical JSON content of a manifests/<manifestHash>/manifest.sig file. Immutable once created for a given manifestHash: re-running signing with the same manifest and the same key must reproduce these exact bytes, and creating a different keyId or signature for an existing manifestHash is rejected.

keyId.description: 'ed25519-' followed by the lowercase hex64 SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key. Never an arbitrary alias.

signature.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature (86 characters cover 512 bits with 4 padding bits that must be zero). This pattern only checks length and character set; exact decodability, the zero-padding-bits requirement, and the decoded length being exactly 64 bytes are enforced by Core model validation, not by this pattern.
